frequency_question: What proportion of expiring bilateral water-sharing treaties are successfully renewed or replaced by a new formal treaty on or before their expiration date?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral water-sharing treaties between sovereign states with fixed expiration dates or mandatory review clauses requiring a new successor treaty. Excludes multilateral agreements and non-binding memoranda.
coverage_note: 5 major named historical precedents; universal success rate among major structured renewals in this class.
known_gaps: Excludes minor or unpublicized local watershed pacts.
skeleton: Global bilateral water treaty renegotiations reaching expiration windows
validity_reason: Matches the final resolution date of the target question.
